notes: Activity logging recovery with GPS as optional add-on. Outdoor activities can be saved accurately even if GPS route capture fails.
summary: Keeps Log Activity usable while GPS/map work continues: duration, exertion, notes, fluids, snacks, symptoms, and stop entries save even when GPS is not captured. GPS data is marked not captured instead of saving fake 0.00-mile distance.
label: ActivityLoggingRecoveryGpsOptional
whatsNew: GPS route/distance is now additive and no longer treated as required for a valid activity log.
If GPS fails, the activity can still be saved with duration, effort, notes, fluids, snacks, symptoms, and stop entries.
GPS save data now records captured/not captured status so missing GPS is not mistaken for a real 0.00-mile route.
Location Status text now explains that health logging continues while GPS is searching or unavailable.
fixes: Prevents failed GPS from skewing activity records with fake zero-distance GPS data.
Keeps distanceSource blank unless a real GPS point was captured.
Adds user-facing help for saving outdoor activities when GPS is unavailable.
